public_boundary.rule: Use MCP/Application public read tools only; do not construct consumer input with direct SQLite queries.

canonical_scope.rule: Every Context Object resolves to the intended stable object_id and current accepted Version unless the case explicitly pins a Version; no rejected, staging, or unintended historical Knowledge.

retrieval_integration.rule: The comparison candidate must come from find_similar_objects and the returned candidate ID must be passed to build_context without hardcoding the comparison target.

context_contract.rule: Response uses sgokb.context-builder.v1, preserves requested purpose/options, identifies each Object and resolved Version, and contains no Context-Builder-authored semantic synthesis.

traceability.rule: Context retains stable Object and resolved Version identities and, where evidence refs are requested, preserves public provenance references.

budget_contract.rule: budget.limit_characters equals the request, used_characters does not exceed the limit, and omission/truncation metadata follows the Context Builder contract without partial statement truncation.

canonical_invariance.rule: Canonical Object/Version/Knowledge/Source/Evidence/Provenance state is unchanged before and after the formal run.

integrity.rule: system integrity passes after the formal read-only run.

regression.rule: Focused Knowledge Access tests, full pytest, Ruff, and git diff check finish successfully.

result_policy.case_pass: Every gate required by that case must PASS.
result_policy.overall_pass: All three cases PASS and all global gates PASS.
result_policy.blocked: A required SGOKB runtime is unavailable so the formal gate cannot be evaluated.
